It's clearly just standard industry poaching and nothing to do with our internal culture.

[Quarterly Turnover Raw Data]

- Sales Turnover: 3.1% (Low)
- HR/Admin Turnover: 2.5% (Low)
- Engineering Turnover: 25.0% (Significant spike)
- Marketing Turnover: 4.0% (Stable)
